title: Endoscopic evaluation of the gastrotolerance of short‐term antalgic treatment with low dose k‐diclofenac: a comparison of ibuprofen and aspirin

sections.abstract: <jats:p>In a short‐term gastro‐duodenal endoscopic study in 12 healthy volunteers, the gastrotoxicity was not different after intake of diclofenac‐K 12.5 mg (0.33) or ibuprofen 200 mg (0.42, <jats:italic>P</jats:italic>=0.66) but significantly higher after aspirin 500 mg (2.67, <jats:italic>P</jats:italic>=0.002).</jats:p>
